description: SOLID golden corpus (E7) with the declared architecture: `stoa eval test/corpus/solid/project --expected test/corpus/solid/expected-architecture.json --solid --architecture test/corpus/solid/stoa.architecture.json`. The DIP layer rule runs as stage 2 instead of stage 1: forbidden ui → data edge and the banned package; ui → state and ui → model are allowed; lib/contracts and web have no layer.
